subject: AWS listing: DataFlux integration - catalog copy + legal proofing
messages:
From: Emily Brown <emily.brown@dataflux.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS listing: initial catalog copy + legal checklist request

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough today — the team at DataFlux is excited about the Redwood inference integration. We're starting the AWS Marketplace listing prep and wanted to kick off a short review of the product page copy and any legal evidence you'll need from us.

High level asks:
- Can you review the attached initial catalog copy (catalog_copy_v1.md) and suggest wording edits for the hero and bullets?
- Are there any specific evidence docs you need for trust claims (SOC2, data residency, encryption at rest)?
- Do you have a recommended export of our logos/AMI/artifacts for the marketplace tile (we'll upload to the portal once approved)?

We'd like to have the copy locked by EOD Friday so our procurement team can start the private offer paperwork early next week (deal id DFX-4821).

Attached: DataFlux_AWS_Assets.zip (logos, hero images, AMI metadata), catalog_copy_v1.md (draft).

If it's easier, happy to do a quick 20-min sync — availability Thu/Fri this week.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Brown
Head of Partnerships, DataFlux Inc.
emily.brown@dataflux.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

[Attachment: DataFlux_AWS_Assets.zip (images, AMI_metadata.json)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Emily Brown <emily.brown@dataflux.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing: initial catalog copy + legal checklist request

Emily — great meeting, thanks for sending these over. Looping in Kim and Marissa from our marketplace + legal intake teams to triage.

Quick notes after a first pass on catalog_copy_v1.md:
- Hero: tighten to one sentence + a clear CTA. Suggest: "Low-latency LLM inference for customer-facing apps — predictable latency and cost across hosted & private deployments." (I'll put a marked-up draft in the drive.)
- Bullets: add one bullet about "dedicated capacity" and one about "private deployment (VPC/on-prem)" so the enterprise buyer sees parity with Redwood's offering.
- Metering language: avoid committing to per-hour billing labels on the page — we should use "usage-based billing" and leave exact tiers to the private offer.

Kim: can you confirm what trust evidence we should ask DataFlux for? My notes: SOC 2 type II report (if they have), an encryption whitepaper or statement of KMS usage, and a short note on data retention and logs. Any other gaps?

Marissa: can you review the attached assets and the hero image direction? If the AMI metadata has required fields for AWS, flag them now so we can avoid a back-and-forth during onboarding.

Proposed next steps:
1) Kim to list required evidence by EOD Thu.
2) Marissa to annotate the catalog copy with UI constraints and image specs by Thu afternoon.
3) I will consolidate and send a single feedback package to Emily on Fri morning so DataFlux can start procurement.

If you prefer a call, I can block Thu 11:00-11:30 PT — otherwise we'll do asynchronous.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: catalog_copy_v1_notes.md (text)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing: initial catalog copy + legal checklist request

Karthik — thanks for the ping. Quick legal intake summary below (I'll attach a redlined checklist):

Required from a marketplace readiness perspective:
- SOC 2 Type II report or equivalent third-party audit (redacted OK)
- Encryption posture: short statement on encryption at rest + KMS usage, and whether customer-managed keys are supported
- Data residency: confirmation of where customer data may be processed and any cross-border transfer controls
- Support SLA: clarification if DataFlux will provide 24/7 support for marketplace customers or route to Redwood support for infra issues
- Acceptable use & export controls questionnaire (we can provide our form for alignment)

Notes on copy: avoid absolute claims like "enterprise-grade" without evidence; prefer phrasing such as "built for enterprise scenarios" and then call out specific features (dedicated pools, private deployment, KMS). Also one small flag: the catalog_copy_v1 uses "AMI" in the hero line — better to reference "AMI/container image" in the technical details section and keep hero buyer-friendly.

Attached: legal_redlines.docx (checklist + inline edit suggestions).

I'll be available to join a Friday sync if helpful.

— Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Compliance | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: legal_redlines.docx (docx)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Emily Brown <emily.brown@dataflux.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing: initial catalog copy + legal checklist request

Emily — consolidated feedback below and next steps. Thanks for the quick turnaround on assets.

Summary of changes we've requested (high level):
- Hero rewrite for clarity and single CTA (see suggestion below).
- Two new bullets to call out Dedicated Capacity and Private Deployments.
- Metering language toned down to "usage-based billing" and leave exact SKU/tier labeling for the private offer.
- Legal/evidence checklist requested: SOC 2 Type II (redacted accepted), KMS/encryption statement, data residency note, and support model confirmation.
- AMI note: include both AMI and container image metadata in the technical section; don't use AMI in hero language.

Proposed hero (we will push this exact string to the draft in Drive):
"Low-latency LLM inference for customer-facing apps — predictable latency and cost across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."

Action items and timeline:
- Emily/DataFlux: upload redacted SOC 2 (if available), encryption statement, and support commitment to the Drive link by Mon 5/20.
- Marissa: I'll leave comments in catalog_copy_v1.md with image specs and CTA placement by EOD Fri.
- Kim: legal checklist is attached; please advise if we should route any evidence requests via procurement/partner onboarding.
- Karthik: I'll open the HubSpot deal (DFX-4821) with these notes and set private offer prep for next week once evidence is uploaded.

Doc links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3CDataFluxAssets (uploads), HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/DFX-4821
DocuSign (procurement template prep): https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123

If you want a 20-min call to finalize language, I can do Mon 8:30-9:00 PT. Otherwise we'll proceed asynchronously.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into Marketplace next week.
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: catalog_copy_v1_marked.md (text)]
